summary: Orchid Fleet Systems evaluating Redwood Dedicated for a latency-sensitive, high-throughput routing assistant and fleet chat. Primary needs: tight p95 latency SLOs for short-turn dialogs, predictable reserved GPU capacity for peak routing windows, cross-region failover for 24/7 operations, and demonstrated fallback behavior under saturation. Strong emphasis on VPC/private deployment and SOC2-like controls.

capacity_plan: Initial reserved commit: 8x A100-40GB equivalent GPU slots for steady-state routing (expected baseline concurrency ~350 chat sessions / 2M tokens/day). Plan includes 50% burst capacity via reserved burst pool (additional 4 GPUs) and autoscaling headroom to add ephemeral nodes for seasonal peaks. Expected scale path: Month 1 POC -> Month 2 steady: add 4 GPUs; Year 1 target commit: 12-16 GPUs. Engineering asked for token-level cost model for quantized variants to evaluate tradeoffs.
sla_expectations: Requested uptime: 99.95% (monthly). Latency SLOs: p50 < 45ms, p95 < 180ms for median 32-token prompts; tail protections for 256-token prompts p95 < 600ms. Orchid requested explicit penalties/credits for missed SLOs and a clause for 'performance remediation' (engine tuning + capacity increase) within 72 hours of any sustained breach. Also asked for scheduled maintenance windows and notification SLA (72-hour notice).
reliability_design: Proposed reliability architecture discussed with SE: primary dedicated pool in us-west-2 with hot standby in us-east-1. Cross-region failover via DNS prefix routing + health-check probes; warm KV cache replication for most frequent prefixes to reduce cold-start latency during failover. Model variant fallback policy: normal->primary model (rlhf-xxl-16k fp16) -> degraded quant8 variant (rlhf-xxl-quant8) under sustained saturation -> smaller low-latency family (rlhf-large-6.9B) if latency > SLO and queued requests exceed threshold. Routing policy includes token-budget based shedding for low-priority telemetry calls, and canary ramping for model rollouts. Also discussed rate-limited queue with graceful degradation messages to apps and automatic rollback if quality drops beyond configured eval thresholds.
poc_notes: POC metrics defined: sustained throughput target 420 req/s for routing assistant (avg 48 tokens/request), embedding ingestion peak 6k qps for batch bulk updates, latency p95 target 180ms. Observed during synthetic burst: p95 drift to 420ms when concurrency spikes >2x baseline; root causes: KV cache miss amplification and kernel scheduling contention. Immediate mitigations tried: reduce batch window size, enable continuous batching controls, and enable quantized model fallback during bursts. Next POC steps: run controlled cross-region failover test, validate tail latencies on quant8 model vs baseline, and finalize reserved GPU sizing for steady-state + 50% burst. Orchid legal to send redlines on MSA by 2026-03-20.
